segments.title: One search box on a New Tab page
segments.body: Address bar in the sidebar, ⌘L set to open the command bar in the centre. Click the sidebar's empty field on a New Tab page and type: the letters now land in the page's own box. 0.2.44-nightly.2 opened the centred bar on top of it, two search boxes stacked.

segments.title: A real emoji picker
segments.body: Change… on a profile's icon now opens a picker: search all emoji, browse categories or SF Symbols, current icon highlighted. 0.2.44-nightly.2 had a menu of 20 symbols and 20 emoji, drawn here from Ardia's log: a hidden test window can't show menus.

segments.title: Names save when you click away
segments.body: Rename a profile, then click somewhere else. Ardia now saves the name, and the list shows it. 0.2.44-nightly.2 saved it only on Return, so going back to the list lost the new name.
